newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Don Group half year earnings tumble.
newsitem.headline: Don Group half year earnings tumble.

text.p: Half year ended Dec 31, 1996 (million rand unless stated)
Full name: The Don Group Ltd (hotels)

NOTE - The company said results were lower than expected largely because of poor results from the food division, reduced Don Apartment occupancy levels due to greater competition and higher interest rates. The exceptional item relates to costs written off in certain discontinued restaurant activities.

Despite the disappointing results, the company said it had firmly established intself as the dominant player in the executive apartment hotel niche sector and was well-placed to take advantage of tourism and business travel "once the menace imposed by crime is reduced".
Subject to a satisfactory solution regarding the food business, profits should increase.
